title: [Main]Payment Discount with Prices Incl. VAT provides unexpected results in the Spanish version
summary: Payment discount calculations now correctly apply to VAT amounts in the Spanish version when prices include VAT, fixing an issue where discounts were not reflected in sales and purchase totals.
key_points: Fixes payment discount calculations when Prices Including VAT setting is enabled
Corrects VAT base recalculation by subtracting payment discount amount
Issue only affected Spanish localization with specific VAT settings (zero base discount and EC amount)
Adds test coverage for payment discount scenarios with VAT-inclusive pricing
quote: Payment discounts are not correctly reflected in sales and purchase totals and statistics when the VAT base discount percentage and EC amount are zero.
